outputs: Generated text sequences for various NLG tasks including summarization, dialogue, paraphrase, style transfer, story generation, and question generation

changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names to consistent capitalization (e.g., 'Style Transfer' instead of 'style transfer'). Removed duplicate task entries. Corrected dataset name 'Topi-calChat' to 'TopicalChat'. Removed model size specifications (BART-LARGE/BERT-LARGE) as they refer to the same base models.
Extracted metrics were already correctly normalized to base forms (BLEU, ROUGE, Distinct). No changes needed.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper only uses traditional automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, Distinct) and no LLM-based evaluation methods.
The paper does not mention any human evaluation of the generated outputs. Only automatic metrics were used for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper presents PTG, a prompt-based transfer learning method for NLG tasks. It evaluates on 14 datasets across 6 generation tasks using automatic metrics only. The extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed for consistent capitalization and duplicate removal.
